purpose: A template for noting the quantities a rule leaves open and the decisions changed after the values were seen, with the reason, the alternatives tried and the images that used each one, filled in for works 1 and 2 as the worked example (the only record of decisions in the main text). It is the table readers copy for their own series.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1 and results/work1_drawing and the record of the decisions in the working notes. Version 2 (2026-10-28, still before any script or drawing), after the cross review of the task: every image a quantity acted on is listed (no 'all'; common_eps.png added where it applies); each value is a path to a key or a literal checked against one. Version 3 (2026-10-29, after round 5 of the pre-review, still before any change of the script and before anything of version 3 is drawn; question 3 of the verdict of round 5 and decision 3 of .steering/20261029-generation-record-v28): table 1 of the paper is dropped and this note becomes the only record of decisions in the main text, as the worked example of works 1 and 2. Six rows of work 2 are added, chosen by the rule 'the two sides of the central comparison, the quantities that the look of the main images of work 2 depends on, and one decision of interpretation' (the other decisions of work 2 stay in the full table of supplement S1); a fifth column names who judged the look and with which guide; the column of images marks the images on which the effect of the quantity was compared; a row whose claim was weakened in the paper after the values were seen is marked with a dagger. Seen before version 3: everything of version 2 and its outputs, the blind judgement and its scoring, figure 6, the record of the quantities of generation (results/paper_generation_record) and rounds 3 to 5 of the pre-review. Version 4 (2026-10-29, after round 6 of the critiques of earlier drafts, still before any change of the script and before anything of versions 3 or 4 is drawn; question 4 of the verdict of round 6, adopted by the researcher): a sixth column 'Reason (and alternatives tried)' is added, worded from the reason and alternative columns of the full decision table of the outline (advice/outline-v2.8.md, outside the repository) as statements of the makers, not checked against a file; the subject of work 2 is moved into a band 'Record of the paper'; the when of map B states that the comparison was read after the scoring; 'critiques of earlier drafts' replaces 'pre-review'; the judged of the subject says it is not a judgement of a look; the value of the subject states the unit of the judgement (the rows of the two authors within one version). When the words of the table were estimated (about 860 with 14 rows) the researcher decided to show only five rows in short wording, at most 340 words with the empty table (the estimate of the conditions was 332), the rest in S1. Seen before version 4: everything seen before version 3, round 6 of the critiques and its verdict. Nothing of version 3 was drawn; results/decision_note_v4 replaces results/decision_note_v3 as the output. Amended before any run (2026-10-29): a trial render of the script in a scratch directory, with the checks of HEAD switched off and nothing kept, stopped at the check of the words (351 against 340, the legend of the dagger not being in the estimate); five cells and the meaning of the dagger were worded shorter, with the same content. The trial showed only the text of these conditions; after it the reason of the drawing was reworded ('Tried: no other viewpoint' read as an alternative tried) and the legend given a gap above it.

row_rule: the main text shows only the rows that bear on its claims (decision of the researcher, 2026-10-29, on the word count, replacing the rule of version 3): the two sides of each comparison whose effect the paper reports (work 1: the height scale, whose alternative is the per-tile min-max, and the drawing; work 2: map B and the percentiles) and one decision of interpretation (the subject of work 2, under the band 'Record of the paper' because it is a decision about what the paper claims and not a quantity of the works); every other decision of works 1 and 2 is in the full table of supplement S1, with the longer wording
acted_on_labels: in the repository the column holds the image files; the numbers of the figures of the paper are put in when the manuscript is made, outside the repository

layout.empty_template: the same table with the six headers and three empty rows is drawn below it
titles: Decision note, filled in for works 1 and 2
layout.row_order: a band 'Work 1' and its rows, a band 'Work 2' and its rows, then a band 'Record of the paper' and its row, each in the order of the conditions
layout.print: drawn in one grey channel (mode L) on white, with no colour; every font size is at least 7 pt at the printed width
layout.legend: under the filled table, one line: the meaning of the dagger, after its mark

outputs: results/decision_note_v4/decision_note.png, decision_note.md (the same table as text) and decision_note.json (the values read, the SHA-256 of the conditions, the counts of words); results/decision_note (version 2) is kept
words: the words drawn are counted as whitespace-separated tokens of the text of each cell, the headers, the band labels and the titles, for the filled and the empty table, a path of an image counting as one word; the counts are recorded and enter the word count of the outline (the template of the journal counts tables and charts); the run stops if the two tables together exceed max_words
not_claimed: A way of noting decisions; it does not show that noting them helps a reader (no study with people). Disclosure helps a reader repeat the work but does not by itself settle whether a reading is valid or a choice biased. The column of who judged names the judgement made, not the viewers of the paper; 'none recorded' means no look was judged with a sheet, not that the makers did not look. The five rows are chosen by the rule above, not as the decisions that mattered most. The reasons are the makers' statements as recorded in the decision table; they are not checked against a file and do not show that a choice was right.
checks: every file named exists and is the one at HEAD; every key read exists; every must_contain string occurs in the keys named (else the run stops)
every image of compared is one of acted_on of its row; the judged of each row is a non-empty literal, checked where a check is given; exactly the rows with dagger true carry the mark
every row has a reason with a non-empty why and a list tried of non-empty strings (possibly empty)
2 rows of work 1, 2 of work 2 and 1 of the record of the paper (asserted as constants), and 6 columns
the image is mode L, its width is the width of the layout at its dpi, and the font is at least 7 pt
the words of the two tables together are at most max_words

dagger.meaning: its claim in the paper was weakened after the values were seen
